executiveSummary: Catastrophic cross-border flooding and landslides along the Nepal-China (Tibet) frontier have caused mass casualties, isolated mountain communities, and widespread infrastructure destruction, with the death toll surpassing 1,000 and more than 4,400 missing. View Article Rescue and access operations remain severely constrained by destroyed bridges and roads, with satellite imagery confirming extensive damage across multiple districts in Nepal and into Tibet/China. View Article A barrier lake upstream presents an additional outburst flood risk, compounding dangers for downstream communities and responders. Supporting Report UNICEF reports at least 17,000 children urgently need assistance and dozens of schools were destroyed or damaged in the Nepal-Tibet flood zone, signaling acute education and protection needs. View Article In the United States, a deadly flash flood in Grand Canyon National Park killed at least two people, left others missing, and destroyed the park's sole water pipeline, triggering broad closures and restrictions. Source Wildfires in Nevada prompted mass evacuations around Reno, destroying homes and stretching response capacity under a state of emergency. View Article Tropical Storm Edouard approaches the Texas-Louisiana Gulf Coast with forecast heavy rain and flooding; preparedness measures and potential evacuations are underway. Security Advisory Note: Figures vary across sources; casualty and missing counts may change as assessments are updated.
